fields.tender_title: Procurement, Installation, Commissioning and Maintenance of Servers

questions.query: What server-related procurement is SBI inviting bids for?
questions.gold_span: REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (GLOBAL TENDER) FOR PROCUREMENT, INSTALLATION, COMMISSIONING AND MAINTENANCE OF SERVERS

questions.gold_span: Last date and time for Bid submission Up to 17:00 on 30/04/2025

questions.query: What earnest money deposit was required for this tender?
How long is the included hardware warranty, and what maintenance follows it?
questions.gold_span: Supply, installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of computer hardware (Servers) along with peripherals/software components, with warranty period for first 5 years and further 2 years AMC.

questions.query: How many servers are included in the described deliverables?
